mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asset (id, user_id, template_id, original_name, stored_name, mime_type, size_bytes, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{templateId}, #{originalName}, #{storedName}, #{mimeType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, template_id, original_name, stored_name, mime_type, size_bytes, created_at FROM asset WHERE id IN #{item}
